QuestInfo.name: Sky High
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Administrator wants to let you know something...
QuestInfo.1: The Maple Administrator told you that if you want to soar through the sky, meet #bInstructor Irvin#k in the Stations of Victoria, Ereve, Orbis, Mu Lung, Ariant, Edelstein, or Leafre.
QuestInfo.2: Instructor Irvin gave you the #b#t2430249##k as a gift, saying it was for people who want to take to the skies.

0.0: Hello Explorer. I have something to tell you.
0.1: The sky is so clear today! Ahh, I feel like I could just fly away. Wouldn't it be nice to soar through the sky?
0.2: I think you know how I feel. Heh. Now, what would you say if I told you that there IS a way to fly? Interested?

yes.0: It's nothing complicated. See, everyone can fly if they have an #bairplane#k, of course. Ah, but where do you get an airplane? Well, there's a retired pilot, #bInstructor Irvin#k, who is currently renting out airplanes.
yes.1: Instructor Irvin can be found in the Stations of #bVictoria, Ereve, Edelstein, Orbis, Mu Lung, Ariant, or Leafre#k. So if you want to rent an airplane, you should go see him!

no.0: Oh, come on! I KNOW you're interested! Just admit it.

1.0: Oh, did the Maple Administrator send you? Interested in an airplane?
1.1: You... You don't know what an airplane is? Well, I guess it is a little new. It's, er, a bit like the mounts that you have, but can take you long distances, like to other continents.

yes.0: There are some things you must know before I can give you an airplane. Listen carefully.
yes.1: First, airplanes are very new to Maple World. They are similar to mounts, but you can ride them to distant continents. Just not all continents, okay?
yes.2: You can fly to #bVictoria Island, Ereve, Edelstein, Ludibrium, Ariant, Mu Lung, or Leafre#k from #bOrbis#k, using the airplane. You can also fly the opposite route, of course. Lastly, you can fly to #bVictoria Island#k from #bEdelstein#k, and vice-versa. These are the only locations you can take an airplane to... The others are a bit too dangerous yet...
yes.3: If you want to head to another continent, you need to speak with a member of the Station staff first. If they have an available airplane, they will offer you that, or a space on a regular ship.

npc.0: Instructor Irvin acn be found in the Stations of Victoria, Ereve, Edelstein, Orbis, Mu Lung, Ariant, or Leafre. So, if you want to rent an airplane, you should go see him!
